title: The Open Air
author: Richard Jefferies
description: "The Open Air" by Richard Jefferies is a collection of essays written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: The book explores themes of nature, the beauty of the countryside, and the connection between humans and the natural world.

authorInfo.bio: Richard Jefferies (1848–1887) wrote The Story of My Heart: An Autobiography. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
